ruledOutDirections.text: **Pass duration as a standalone signal:** real deepseek passes run as short as 33 s (finding 5).
**A run-level lock through `loop-lock.cjs`.** That lock is per-loop and per-artifact-dir, and the lineages already hold their own. A runner lock at the base directory is simpler (finding 4).
**Treating a quota hit as retryable.** That would burn the same allowance again. The current non-retryable class is right; only the rerun path is missing.
**AutoGen's text-mention termination as a model:** a stop the model announces itself is exactly the self-report this work is trying to avoid.
**Inspect `working_time` as a pass-duration signal:** its own docs say it can undercount overlapped work, and iteration 1 already found duration alone weak.

Claude Agent SDK hooks: a `PostToolUse` hook could keep an audit trail [SOURCE: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hooks]. Installing one means writing into the operator's Claude config dir, though, and stream-json gives the same events without that write. Dropped in favour of finding 2.
**A minimum-reads threshold:** it flags real context-carried passes (finding 5).
**Finding-id novelty as an observed ratio:** ids are minted fresh on every pass.
**Mirrors as a source of fan-out divergence:** the persona is inlined from `.skilled` (finding 7).
